sources.snippet: Generative AI focuses on building models that can create new content such as text, images, audio and code by learning patterns from existing data to generate human‑like outputs across various domains. It is widely used in chatbots, content creation, design and automation.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Tutorial - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Artificial Intelligence (AI) refers to the simulation of human intelligence in machines which allows them to think and act like humans. It involves creating algorithms and systems that can perform tasks that require human abilities such as visual perception, speech recognition, decision-making and language translation.
